args.reason: Beyond the dry-run flag, the DoD adds a persisted .faff/merge-gate-history/<pr>.jsonl log, an --explain timeline, a --since filter and a --format toggle. The PRD says historical storage and query features are outside its scope, so this capability goes past the declared goals. That is gold-plating, not under-citation. The Phase-1 claim that it is a natural extension of inspection ignores the explicit exclusion.
